name: Kenney Mini Characters animation library
description: Low-poly mini humanoid with 32 baked clips including wheelchair locomotion. 12 skins exist in the upstream pack; this asset keeps one representative mesh+clips (character-male-a) to avoid recolor padding. Clips: static, idle, walk, sprint, jump, fall, crouch, sit, drive, die, pick-up, emote-yes, emote-no, holding-right, holding-left, holding-both, holding-right-shoot, holding-left-shoot, holding-both-shoot, attack-melee-right, attack-melee-left, attack-kick-right, attack-kick-left, interact-right, interact-left, wheelchair-sit, wheelchair-look-left, wheelchair-look-right, wheelchair-move-forward, wheelchair-move-back, wheelchair-move-left, wheelchair-move-right.
author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
attribution: Credit Kenney.nl not required but appreciated.
retargeting_requirement: Kenney mini rig; not verified for Roblox R15/R6
source_note: Same 32 clips are shared across 12 character skins; skins not duplicated.
